items.title: UK retailer The Fragrance Shop launches online with Affirm and preps go live across store estate
items.why: Affirm is expanding into retail store estates, so BNPL competition for point-of-sale checkout is intensifying.
items.summary_ai: UK retailer The Fragrance Shop launched online with Affirm financing and plans to roll it out across its stores.
items.take: Affirm is expanding into retail store estates, so BNPL competition for point-of-sale checkout is intensifying.
